data.body: Investigation complete (BASIC). ROOT_CAUSE: no review.non_reviewable_doc_dirs config key exists; non-reviewable classification is a static plugin-shipped allowlist with the only host override being the test-isolation env vars ALLOWLIST_OVERRIDE/CONF_OVERRIDE. Confirmed: (H1) no config key exists; (H2) docs outside docs/** -> exit 1 (full review); (H3) skills/ force-reviewed in skip-review-check.sh (case block runs before _matches_allowlist). KEY SAFETY FINDING: compute-diff-hash.sh has NO force-review guard (unlike skip-review-check.sh), so a misconfigured key including an LLM-instruction dir would silently drop it from the review hash -> hash-integrity hole. docs/** exemption present since the file's creation (966a7a5dc3); current DSO does NOT expose host-configurable doc dirs. Insertion points: skip-review-check.sh after line 74 (append to _ALLOWLIST_PATTERNS, before classification loop so force-review case still wins); compute-diff-hash.sh after line 171 (append to EXCLUDE_PATHSPECS). Fix complexity: MODERATE (single subsystem). Modifies safeguard files -> user approval required.
